diagnostic_description: Label-free diagnostic over 18 candidate questions before relevance scoring

summary.diagnosis: The local vector vault (Chroma collections 'ieee_papers' and 'ieee_papers_parent') exists on disk but contains 0 chunks. All 18 candidate queries return 0 chunks from search_vault.

remediation_steps: Run 'python database.py' to ingest and chunk all 66 PDFs from 'papers/' directory into './vector_vault'.
Once ingested, re-run 'python evaluator.py --dataset reviewed_dataset.json --index-tag <actual-tag> --protocol within_first_ten_chunks' to compute live retrieval scores.
